sections.content: szokott is a special helper verb: pair it with an infinitive (ending in -ni) to say someone habitually does something. szokott tanulni means 'usually studies' — szokott carries the person's ending, and the main verb stays frozen in its infinitive -ni form.

items.english: At school they usually study too.
I usually do sports, but sometimes I rest.

sections.content: Don't conjugate the second verb — szokott already carries the 'usually does' meaning, so tanulni stays in its -ni form no matter who the subject is.
